journey.name: View and Scroll Stories Listing
journey.description: Verifies that the user lands on the Discover feed, views cross-platform stories, filters by tech stack, and can scroll down the list of stories.

actions.action: Verify that the app displays the "Discover" feed
Verify that the tech stack filter chips "All", "KMP", "Flutter", and "React Native" are visible
Verify that app story cards are visible on screen
Swipe up to scroll down through the list of app stories
Verify that new app story cards are displayed after scrolling
Verify that only Flutter stories are displayed
Verify that all stories are displayed
